chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: 'It is not permissible for the one praying to pray except with one ablution, unless a new event occurs or he touches his body with something of impurity.'

key_terms.الْحَدَث: Ritual impurity event (e.g., urination, defecation, sleep)

ai.seo_question: What nullifies the validity of a single ablution for prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that wudu remains valid for multiple prayers unless a specific nullifier occurs, countering the notion that each prayer requires a fresh ablution. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of 'continuity of purity' (istishab al-taharah), emphasizing that ritual state persists until proven otherwise by a distinct event of hadath or contact with najasah.
